extraction.name: SWE-rebench
extraction.description: A public dataset comprising over 21,000 interactive Python-based SWE tasks, suitable for reinforcement learning of SWE agents at scale, constructed using a scalable, fully automated pipeline for continuous collection of software engineering tasks from real-world GitHub repositories.
extraction.license: Permissive open-source licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-4-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, ISC, CC0-1.0, ZPL-2.1)
extraction.creator: Ibragim Badertdinov, Alexander Golubev, Maksim Nekrashevich, Anton Shevtsov, Simon Karasik, Andrei Andriushchenko, Maria Trofimova, Daria Litvintseva, Boris Yangel
extraction.citeAs: Badertdinov, I., Golubev, A., Nekrashevich, M., Shevtsov, A., Karasik, S., Andriushchenko, A., Trofimova, M., Litvintseva, D., & Yangel, B. (2025). SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A scalable and fully automated pipeline for mining real-world software engineering tasks from GitHub, covering environment configuration, build setup, and test validation. It comprises four stages: preliminary task collection, automated installation instruction configuration, execution-based installation verification, and quality assessment.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Tasks are excluded if they fail in at least one run due to flaky tests with external API calls or floating-point precision issues. Instances with unpinned or obsolete dependencies that cannot be resolved are also excluded.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: GitHub Archive (public events, issues, pull requests) and GitHub (cloned repositories with full commit histories).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The overall patch is divided into a solution patch (changes to non-test files) and a test patch (changes to test files). Project versions are normalized to major.minor format.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering criteria include: issue from a Python repository with a permissive license, issue marked as resolved, PR merged into main branch, PR not linked to multiple issues, issue description longer than 10 characters, PR introduces or modifies tests and includes code changes beyond test files, and changes affect 1 to 15 files.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automated instance quality assessment using a fine-tuned instruction-following model (Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct) trained on human annotations from SWE-bench Verified to predict Issue Clarity, Task Complexity, and Test Patch Correctness.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The fine-tuned model achieved 81% accuracy for Task Complexity, 67% accuracy for Test Patch Correctness, and 79% accuracy for Issue Clarity on the validation set.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and benchmark are continuously updated with a fresh supply of tasks to ensure decontamination. Future work includes maintaining the evaluation process on fresh tasks for existing models and evaluating a wider range of LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: May accelerate the development of increasingly autonomous AI systems in software engineering, bringing potential risks such as overreliance on AI-generated code or misuse of automated agents for introducing vulnerabilities.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Limited language diversity (exclusively Python). The automated pipeline relies on heuristics and LLM-driven interpretations, which may not capture every project's subtleties or fully replicate nuanced human judgment.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Automated task quality assessment may result in some tasks being imperfectly described or unsolvable solely from the issue. Limited language diversity (exclusively Python). The LLM-based approach to generating installation instructions was validated on a limited set of 18 repositories.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training (particularly reinforcement learning), Testing, Evaluation, Benchmarking of LLM-based software engineering agents.
